#!/bin/bash
# W2-177 engineer's extra form: the cron nightly's: the REAL HOME, a background job of a non-interactive bash (SIGINT
# ignored at start). usage: bash realhome_bg.sh <tag> <N> [setsid]
set -u
TREE=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-177
OUT=$TREE/.gov-runtime/scratch/eng/$1
N=$2
mkdir -p "$OUT"
cd "$TREE" || exit 2
for i in $(seq 1 "$N"); do
  log=$OUT/real-bg-$i.txt
  if [ "${3:-}" = setsid ]; then
    env HOME=/home/usain setsid bash "$TREE/.gov-runtime/scratch/forms/inner.sh" > "$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & wait $!
  else
    env HOME=/home/usain bash "$TREE/.gov-runtime/scratch/forms/inner.sh" > "$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & wait $!
  fi
  echo "real-home-bg run $i: $(grep -o 'SIGINT-ignored-at-start: [01]' "$log" | head -1) | $(grep -E '^[0-9]+ (passed|failed|error)' "$log" | tail -1)" | tee -a "$OUT/counts.txt"
done

result:
task: DAEO-1k7y (W2-177), engineer, profile FULL, class C2
status: DONE
sandbox check (first): (a) failed with `Read-only file system` and `.sandbox-trial-W2-177` was not created; (b) `git hash-object -w` and `git update-index --refresh` both exited 0. The `ps` check for `ollama`/`llama-server` showed nothing of mine, and I started none. I never ran `gov retrieve` or `gov context`.
work_completed: Both of the lead's causes are confirmed with counts. The six cases now pass in all four start forms, plus a fifth form I added, 10 runs each.
- **(A) `PYTHONUSERBASE` dropped.** `runner._run` (`runner.py:539`) removes every `PYTHON*` variable from the child's environment. Under an empty HOME the child can't import pytest and gov exits 4. This explains cases 2, 4, 5, 6 and R11's three parameters in the empty-HOME foreground form.
- **(B) Background start.** A background job begins with SIGINT ignored and `launch_gov` never reset it, so gov kept the ignore. This alone explains all six in the nightly's own form (real HOME, background start).
- **Evidence:** in the nightly's `parallel.txt`, the R11 premise got `'1 1 0'` where `'1 0 0'` was expected, which shows SIGINT inherited as ignored.
- **Fixes:**
  - `runner.py` keeps the caller's `PYTHONUSERBASE` in the child (two lines).
  - `launch_gov` sets SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP to ignored when named and to default otherwise.
  - `gov accept` is unchanged on inherited ignores, so R11 stays green.
- **New tests:** `test_w2_177_start_forms.py` has 5 cases. Three failed for the intended reasons before the fix, and two are guards that pass before and after.
files_changed: `src/gov/accept/runner.py`, `tests/unit/accept/w2_96_reap.py`, `tests/unit/accept/test_w2_177_start_forms.py` (new), `docs/changes/W2-177-evidence.md` (new). `git diff --name-only 2a35ec307 HEAD` lists only these four. `skip_known.json`, `tests/acceptance/` and every timeout, marker and assertion are untouched.
evidence:
- **Before (counts per run, 9 tests each):**
  - empty-home: 7 failed, 2 passed, twice (424 s).
  - real-home: 9 passed, twice (14 s).
  - setsid-bg: 9 failed, twice.
  - bg-job: 9 failed, twice.
  - real-home-bg (mine, the nightly's form): 6 failed, 3 passed, twice (252 s). The six fail, R11 passes.
- **After (14 tests per run, the nine plus the five new):** empty-home, real-home, setsid-bg, bg-job and real-home-bg each passed 10 of 10 runs (about 14 s each). None failed or was skipped.
- **Unit folder:** `95 passed, 117 deselected in 43.23s`. The 117 are the brief's `-k`/`-m` exclusions plus the repo's opt-in lists, which keep only a parametrised case's first row.
- **Left out of the folder run:** `local_only` cases, and any name containing `real`, `green_here` or `time_limit`. I ran no real model, embedder or reranker.
- **Why some runs passed:**
  - Alone with the real HOME and a foreground start both causes are absent: 9 passed.
  - W2-110's passing verify is `verify-4` (11-12 00:32, hand-driven, empty `driver.log`). Its six cases show `ok` there, but its start form is **not established**.
  - W2-110's later `lead_verify.sh` verify (01:31) had these cases red.
- **Nightly "alone at load 18":** not load. The gate line shows `load=0.9/1.2`. `nightly_cron.sh:19` sets the real HOME, so (A) is absent there. `nightly_alone.py` re-runs each case inside the same background job, so a red "alone" has the same start form as the main run.
- **W2-56's two SIGINT cases:** probably cause (B). Only the SIGINT parameters are red, and `start_launch` (`w2_56_support.py:531-537`) never resets SIGINT. I did not run them.
tests: 5 new cases, all green. R11's three parameters are green in all five forms. Every pytest after the CTO's 0556 order went through `heavy_slot.sh`, with an empty HOME and `PYTHONUSERBASE=/home/usain/.local`.
discoveries:
- **`_popen` has the same gap.** `tests/acceptance/W2-96/w2_96_support.py:1380-1388` only ignores signals, never resets them. This is not mine. It is why five W2-96 acceptance cases stay red in a background start: the R11 premise, the r9 second press, r12 SIGINT, and the at_no_leak interrupted run.
- **W2-56 has it too.** `w2_56_support.py:531-537` (`start_launch`) has the same gap.
- **`nightly_alone.py` re-runs in the same start form.** A "red alone" there can't separate a start-form cause from a defect of the head.
- **Opt-in lists deselect parametrised rows.** They keep only the first row of a parametrised case. `run_forms.sh` counts any "deselected" in a summary as red, so the new test file has no parametrised case.
- **Scratch is write-denied.** The guard refused my write of a script under `.gov-runtime/scratch/eng/`. I ran the extra form as an inline command instead, with output in `$TMPDIR`.
risks:
- **Acceptance gap.** Until a test designer revises the W2-96 and W2-56 acceptance supports, those cases stay red under a background start. A nightly will still show them.
- **Mechanism untested.** I did not run the W2-56 cases, so their shared cause is inferred.
lessons:
- **A masked cause.** In an empty-HOME background start, (A) hid (B): cases 1 and 3 returned 4 rather than 0. A form that isolates each cause, here real HOME plus background, was needed to separate them.
- **Waiting on a log.** `wait_for.sh` on a non-exit file blocks. Use a pid wait, or just read the file.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: the W2-110 passing verify's start form (not established).
recommended_next_action: package a test designer's revision of the W2-96 `_popen` and W2-56 `start_launch` start forms (set each of SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGHUP to ignored or default). Consider a one-line note on `nightly_alone.py`'s same-form re-run. Then merge W2-177.
